bifrost: springboard/core/src/sha256.rs (bifrost_core::sha256), springboard/src/keychain.rs (HMAC-SHA256, ChaCha20, encrypt-then-MAC), springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs (secret storage only)
summary: BifrOSt has SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256 and ChaCha20 inside the shell, used only to protect the keychain file and to verify updates and backups. Apps get no hashing, cipher, signature, key agreement or typed key API; the SDK keychain stores opaque secret bytes. Most of CryptoKit (SHA-2 384/512, SHA-3, AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, Curve25519, NIST curves, HPKE, HKDF, post-quantum KEM and signatures, Secure Enclave) has no counterpart.

features.note: Wave 4 (w4-apple-cryptokit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. SHA-256 only, in the shell's core crate; no SDK type, no SHA-384 or SHA-512, no HashFunction protocol

Wave 4 (w4-apple-cryptokit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no SHA-3 implementation in springboard/

Wave 4 (w4-apple-cryptokit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. HMAC-SHA256 is private to the keychain module; no SymmetricKey type and no HMAC API for apps
ChaCha20 stream cipher only (RFC 8439 block function) with HMAC-SHA256 in place of Poly1305; encrypt-then-MAC is in keychain.rs:305 (seal_with) and :316 (open_box); not exposed to apps

Wave 6 (b16, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. no AES in springboard/; the noVNC JavaScript under springboard/apps/remote is a web client and not used by apps
derives per-app subkeys with HMAC from a master key; this is an ad hoc construction, not HKDF, and is not exposed to apps

features.feature: Typed key storage in the keychain
features.apple: CryptoKit keys stored as keychain items (sample: Storing CryptoKit Keys in the Keychain)
features.note: SDK keychain stores opaque secret bytes keyed by service and account, with a permission; there are no typed key objects and no key references
Apple hardware. The keychain comments say no TPM or login-password key source exists yet (springboard/src/keychain.rs header), so a hardware key source would be a new gap, not a port

Wave 5 (w5-apple-cryptokit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. the shell has no MD5 or SHA-1; only the noVNC web client has MD5
App Store Connect metadata; BifrOSt's PC App Store has no equivalent key in its manifest format

gaps: No app-facing SDK API for any hashing, cipher, MAC or signature primitive; apps can only store opaque secrets
SHA-2 is only SHA-256 and is not exposed; SHA-384, SHA-512 and SHA-3 are missing
No AES-GCM and no ChaCha20-Poly1305 with Poly1305; the shell's ChaCha20 is internal and paired with HMAC instead
No asymmetric crypto: Ed25519, X25519 and NIST curve signatures or key agreement
No HKDF, HPKE or post-quantum KEM and signatures
No typed key objects (SymmetricKey, key references) in the keychain API
No hardware-backed key source (Secure Enclave or TPM)
